shape: Asymmetric square arena, SE quadrant absent (N+E gates)
description: Variant of wetlands-A lb1's twin-hub arena, but with no SE-quadrant detour anchor (the south-east region of the room appears not to be navigable, or there's nothing of dispatch interest there). The north hub is the higher-degree super-hub here — it reaches all corners + center + the east hub directly. The east hub is sparser, connecting only to its gate, the center, and the NE corner.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-5.97, -26.28) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (25.23, -7.66) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: north entry hub (super-hub for this stage) (matches qkbtih)
geometric center anchor — connects to most others (matches e05mq2)

traversalNotes: Direct N↔E: spawn_north → north_inner → east_inner → spawn_east. Three hops via the direct north_inner ↔ east_inner edge (the only place this stage allows a hub-to-hub direct).
SE QUADRANT IS NOT walkable / has no detour anchors — don't emit any edge that would route through positive-X / positive-Z when the source coords place an anchor in that region.

DISPATCH RULE: north_inner is the super-hub and the canonical dispatch anchor — it reaches all 5 detour anchors (corners + center) and both gates. East-side corner objectives (ne_corner) can also dispatch via east_inner. Other corner objectives route via north_inner.

Same primitive family as paru-A lb3 (square arena with one quadrant collapsed) but with different orientation (N+E gates instead of N+E with the NW corner missing). Solver should treat as ib1/lb1 with a coverage mask.
